method: Codex computer-use browser walkthrough, synthetic documents only

checks.observed: Three synthetic imported records appeared with author, year, tags and PDF state.
Rendered page 1 of 3 with selectable word layer.
Clipboard text: Wang, S. (2026). Reading urban change. Synthetic Reading Examples.
Saved Chinese note, reloaded UI and found the same comment on page 1.
Selected sentence, saved a native highlight plus Chinese comment; annotation count rose to 2.
Added related-paper edge; graph displayed both documents and the user-entered reason.
Clicked global export, browser reported all 3 fixture references exported as BibLaTeX.
No captured browser errors or warnings in the final walkthrough.
Standalone UI showed no configured model and offered refresh rather than fabricated AI text.

Actual isolated Harness loaded the 2,000-record catalog. The reader showed paper-library-qa-a / reader-a automatically; changing the composer to QA Reader B changed the reader to paper-library-qa-b / reader-b while the same paper and annotation tab remained open.

Typed an unsaved Chinese page-note draft, changed the actual Harness composer from model B back to A, and observed the same draft text still in the open annotation dialog. The draft was not saved to the fixture PDF.

The local selection-only adapter rejected a synthetic conversation turn before network generation. This made the conversation sidebar available; no external model request was made. Temporary host restart produced expected reconnect warnings, with no captured later reader error. Test host and tab were stopped after verification.
Native app automation could not complete the file-open workflow. No WPS compatibility claim.
Browser process memory was not measured.
